title: Meta AI Agent Platform
description:
Meta just made a big AI move.

And no, this is not just another chatbot.

Meta is entering the AI agent space for businesses — and the important part is not only the AI model.

The important part is the infrastructure.

WhatsApp.
Instagram.
Messenger.

Millions of businesses already talk to customers there every day.

Now imagine AI agents helping inside those conversations:

Answering customers.
Booking appointments.
Qualifying leads.
Supporting sales.
Connecting messages to real business workflows.

This is the shift I care about as an AI engineer:

AI is moving from “chat” to “execution.”

Not replacing human teams — but supporting them with better systems, automation, and workflow intelligence.

I break it down in my new YouTube video from an AI engineering perspective:

What Meta launched.
Why it matters.
And why this could be bigger than it looks.

Link in the first comment.

#AI #AIAgents #MetaAI #AIEngineering #Automation #BusinessAI #ArtificialIntelligence #TechNews #FutureOfWork
